title: Resort Club Memberships Guest Privileges Table
content:
Guest passes, guest fees and guest limits of Resort Club Memberships, level by level.

| Membership level | Guest passes allocated each membership year | Guest fee per guest visit once passes are used up (USD) | Most guests per visit | Facilities a member's guest may use |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fitness Club Membership | 6 | 25.00 | 1 | Fitness centre |
| Pool & Fitness Club Membership | 12 | 35.00 | 2 | Fitness centre, pool |
| Spa Club Membership | 12 | 45.00 | 2 | Fitness centre, pool, spa |
| Beach & Pool Club Membership | 24 | 50.00 | 4 | Fitness centre, pool, beach club |
| Family Resort Club Membership | 24 | 50.00 | 4 | Fitness centre, pool, spa, beach club |
| Founders Resort Club Membership | 52 | 40.00 | 6 | Fitness centre, pool, spa, beach club, cabana |

## Terms common to every level

| Term | Every level |
|---|---|
| Unused passes carry over to the next membership year | No |
| The member must accompany the guest | Yes |
| When passes are allocated and lapse | On the membership anniversary: passes are allocated at the start of each membership year, and the membership year runs from the start date's month and day |

## Notes

- A Founders Resort Club Membership guest may use a cabana; no other level lists the cabana among its guest facilities.
- The spa appears among the guest facilities of the Spa Club Membership, the Family Resort Club Membership and the Founders Resort Club Membership only; the beach club appears among those of the Beach & Pool Club Membership, the Family Resort Club Membership and the Founders Resort Club Membership only.
- The guest fee is not graded strictly by level: the Founders Resort Club Membership charges 40.00, below the 50.00 of the Beach & Pool and Family Resort levels.
